question: Let $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ and $g:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be given by $f(x)=|x|$ and $g(x)=|5x-2|$. Find $g\circ f$ and $f\circ g$. Hence examine whether the two composite functions are equal.
explanation:
Composition $g\circ f$
$$(g\circ f)(x)=g(|x|)=\left|5|x|-2\right|.$$

Composition $f\circ g$
$$(f\circ g)(x)=f(|5x-2|)=\left||5x-2|\right|=|5x-2|.$$

Comparison at a suitable value
For $x=-1$,
$$(g\circ f)(-1)=|5-2|=3,$$
whereas
$$(f\circ g)(-1)=|-5-2|=7.$$

Conclusion
Since the composite functions have different values at $x=-1$,
$$g\circ f\ne f\circ g.$$

options.A: $(g\circ f)(x)=|5x-2|$ and $(f\circ g)(x)=\left|5|x|-2\right|$; hence, they are equal
options.B: $(g\circ f)(x)=5|x|-2$ and $(f\circ g)(x)=5x-2$; hence, they are unequal
options.C: $(g\circ f)(x)=\left|5|x|-2\right|$ and $(f\circ g)(x)=|5x-2|$; hence, they are unequal
